= Third-party dependencies

The machine-contract core uses a vendored JSON header so isolated native targets can
build without downloading that dependency. Original licences are retained beside
vendored files. The Drogon HTTP boundary is fetched at its pinned Git commit by CMake,
or supplied as an exact system package when explicitly requested.

[cols="1,1,2,1",options="header"]
|===
|Dependency |Version |Upstream |License
|nlohmann JSON |3.12.0 |https://github.com/nlohmann/json/tree/v3.12.0[nlohmann/json] |MIT
|Drogon |1.9.13 commit `4c5430757ea5451a7c38fbbef4b4bef7dbb47f2f` |https://github.com/drogonframework/drogon/tree/4c5430757ea5451a7c38fbbef4b4bef7dbb47f2f[drogonframework/drogon] |MIT
|===

The workbench records exact package versions and transitive integrity hashes in
`workbench/package-lock.json`. Svelte, SvelteKit and their tools retain their upstream
licenses. GSAP retains its own upstream license; the project's MIT license does not
relicense dependencies. Node modules are not included in source control.

The `manifest.json` file records vendored-file hashes and source URLs. CMake records
the Drogon pin in `cmake/Dependencies.cmake`. Updating a dependency requires updating
its licence, pin or hash, and verification evidence.
